hook_text: 23 times what makes 552? Three tries and you have it.
clip_script: 23 times box equals 552. There is no times-table fact for that, so try. 20? 23 times 20 is 460. Too small, go bigger. 25? 575. Too big, come down. 24? 23 times 24 is 552. Got it. Every try tells you which way to move. Now prove it: put 24 back in the box and the sentence is true. Another one: box minus 368 equals 1 250. Undo the minus with a plus. 1 250 plus 368 is 1 618. Put it back: 1 618 minus 368 is 1 250. True. Look first, try and improve, then put it back in.
visual_style: A balance scale with a mystery box, tipping too low and too high until it settles level on 24.
mood: Playful, like a game of hotter and colder.
pacing: Three quick tries, a satisfying click when the scale balances, then the inverse example.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make up a missing-number puzzle for a friend.
